test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: In this passage the author:

options.text: explains that by nature man is fond of war
doesn’t think that there is any element in human nature that cannot be curbed
suggests that man’s instinct for fighting can find expression in duels
thinks that man’s nature is unchangeable

solution:
The correct answer is** 'doesn’t think that there is any element in human nature that cannot be curbed.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the passage, the author is saying that there is no element in human nature that can be controlled.
 
• Therefore, in this passage, the author doesn’t think that there is any element in human nature that cannot be curbed.
 
 
• इसलिए, इस passage में, लेखक यह नहीं सोचता है कि मानव स्वभाव में कोई तत्व है जिसे रोका नहीं जा सकता है।
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct option is 'doesn’t think that there is any element in human nature that cannot be curbed.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 
• The meaning of the word** 'curb' **is restrain or keep in check.

 
 
• **Example:** *She promised she would curb her temper.*
